title: Getting Started
intro: Find the right guide for your next battle, upgrade, or event.

sections.title: For battle
paragraphs: Start with PvP Tactics for field fighting and rally etiquette. If an attack is already on the way, use Defending an Attack.

sections.title: For your army
paragraphs: Season 2 to Season 5 guides include commander pairings, equipped skills, and field or rally options. Each build follows the assumptions recorded with that season.

sections.title: For growth
paragraphs: Use Healing & Training to estimate what your inventory supports. Mounts, equipment, experience, fragments, and research each have their own guide.

sections.title: Guide credits
paragraphs: Compiled from the GUL Ultimate Guide for K709. Credits: Thorbjørnsson.
